facts.fact: 夜里 David 驾车载着 Erin 跟随 Jim 的 Jeep 驶离大路开往树林僻静处,并提醒她:没人知道他们来了这里。
facts.anchor: “No one knows we’re here,” David reminded her as he followed Jim’s Jeep off the main roads towards wooded seclusion.

facts.fact: Jim 住在一座小木屋(log cabin)里,位于一条需再经几条土路才能到达的土路上,宅地夹在两侧数英亩未开发林地之间。
facts.anchor: Jim lived in a little log cabin on a dirt road that was only accessible via several other dirt roads.

facts.fact: Jim 拿出自制防护服要求两人穿上;David 说「I am not putting that on」拒绝,Jim 强硬回应:鞋可以不脱,但这一步是 nonnegotiable(不可商量)。
facts.anchor:
“I am not putting that on,” David said. “There’s no way.”


“No,” Jim said forcefully. “You can leave your shoes on in my home if it makes you feel better, but this part is nonnegotiable.”

facts.fact: Erin 照做要去穿防护服时,Jim 却伸手拦住她,说她不用穿(You don’t wear one)。
facts.anchor: “No,” Jim said, putting his arm out to stop her. “You don’t wear one.”

facts.fact: Jim 的地下室里没有架子也没有盒,数千盘空白 VHS 录像带从地板堆到天花板。
facts.anchor: The basement was full of videotapes, thousands of tapes stacked in towering piles.

facts.fact: Jim 命令 Erin 脱掉衣服、跪到电视机前。
facts.anchor: “Take off your clothes and kneel down in front of the television screen,” Jim said.

facts.fact: Erin 看到 Jim 选出的那盘 VHS 标签上印着她的全名 Erin Morrison 和日期 February fifth, 1983;她随即尖叫,与 David 一起逃出木屋驾车离开。
facts.anchor: “It had my name on it. My full name: Erin Morrison. And a date: February fifth, 1983.”

facts.fact: Erin 解释:她只对 Jim 说过自己的名字,并按 David 的嘱咐自我介绍为 Erin;Jim 装作不认识她,但其实认识。
facts.anchor: “I only ever told him my first name,” she said. “I introduced myself as Erin, just like you told me to. And he acted like he didn’t know me. But he did.
